scenario.summary: Adversaries abuse the legitimate Faronics Deploy platform by tricking victims into installing signed installers via Adobe-themed phishing lures. Once enrolled, the attackers use the management software's built-in remote execution capabilities to deploy PowerShell scripts and persistent RMM tools like ScreenConnect.

meta.rationale: Focus on workstations that have Faronics Deploy installed but are not typically managed by that specific RMM solution. Widen the search to any host showing Adobe-named processes that are not published by Adobe.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has used a phishing lure to install a legitimately signed Faronics Deploy agent, then abused its remote script execution capabilities to deploy ScreenConnect and establish persistent access.

hunt.name: Abused Faronics Deploy and RMM Installation
hunt.description: This hunt investigates the abuse of Faronics Deploy, an endpoint management platform. Attackers deliver signed Faronics installers masquerading as Adobe documents. Once installed, they use the platform legitimate deployment functions to execute PowerShell scripts hosted on GitHub, which ultimately install ScreenConnect. The hunt traces this chain from initial access traffic through installer execution to the final RMM deployment, using unique identifiers like the ck parameter to cluster related activity.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%faronics%deploy%'
config.description: Identify hosts that have Faronics Deploy installed to narrow the search for subsequent abuse.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts where the Faronics agent is active. These are the primary targets for the behavioral queries.

primitive_config.label: Identify Faronics Deploy installations

primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts where the Faronics agent is active. These are the primary targets for the behavioral queries.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as resolution_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{phishing_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Find hosts that resolved the attacker controlled domains used for fingerprinting.
config.expected_signal: A host resolving fileportals.gytgtecg.xyz prior to or around the time of a Faronics installation.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, process_file_company, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%adobe%.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%reader%.exe') AND LOWER(process_file_company) LIKE '%faronics%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, url_query, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_hostname) = 'deploy.faronics.com' AND url_query LIKE '%ck=%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Capture the enrollment request containing the unique customer/deployment identifier used by the attacker.
config.expected_signal: HTTP requests to deploy.faronics.com that include a ck value. This confirms the host was enrolled in a specific Faronics environment.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%screenconnect%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%screenconnect%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
